About this Event

DESIBEATZ PRESENTS

DnD – DANDIYA N DISCOSan Jose, this isn’t your regular garba night.
DnD – Dandiya n Disco brings the energy of garba to the dance floor for a night packed with glowing dandiyas, festive rhythms and nonstop Bollywood energy.
Join us on the patio at Continental as DJ Brown Buoy blends traditional garba favorites with disco dandiya, Bollywood bangers and club-ready beats.
WHAT TO EXPECT
✨ LED dandiyas provided
🪩 Disco dandiya and club-style garba
🥁 Garba favorites and Bollywood anthems
🎧 Music by DJ Brown Buoy
💃 Festive fits and nonstop dancing
No dandiyas? No problem—we’ve got you covered. Grab your crew, dress festive and come ready to light up the dance floor.
EVENT DETAILS
📅 Friday, October 16
⏰ 10:00 PM–1:30 AM
📍 Continental
349 S 1st St, San Jose, CA
🔞 21+ only
TICKETS & VIP
🎟 $5 tickets available for a limited time
There is no free guest list for this event.
🍾 $200 VIP Table
Includes one bottle of alcohol and admission for up to six guests.
IMPORTANT INFORMATION
• This event is strictly 21+.
• A valid, physical government-issued photo ID is required for entry.
• All ticket sales and VIP reservations are final. No refunds.
• Event details, entertainment and timings are subject to change.
PHOTO & VIDEO DISCLAIMER
Photography and video recording will take place during this event. By entering the venue, you consent to being photographed or recorded and authorize the event organizers and venue to use this content for promotional, marketing and social media purposes without compensation.
Traditional energy. Disco attitude. One glowing dance floor.
This is DnD.
